dollars

metered: pi-ai computed price
estimated (~): partly measured
plan: covered by a subscription, never a dollar

unknown: not measured, not guessed

edges

config: the trigger names this flow
observed ×n: chained in run records
potential: a text mention, not a promise
potential (strong): near chain vocabulary
cron re-arm: the schedule itself
